content.text:
The five links are templates only. Adding them gives you a copy of each bot. The tool calls stay disconnected until you create a Waypoint account and attach that account’s key. **Try the demo** on the live site does not issue a key, so it cannot authorize those calls.

## 1. Create the account that the tools talk to

1. Open [https://waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com/login/?mode=signup](https://waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com/login/?mode=signup) and choose **Create an account**.
2. Finish setup and add one person. Until that profile exists, every tool call answers that there is nobody to act for.
3. Open **Settings → Connect your Bots**. Copy the connector address and your key. The address is `https://waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com/mcp`. The header is `Authorization: Bearer` plus the key shown there.

## 2. Add your own copy of each template

In the Grok Bot desktop app, open each link and click **Add to Grok Bot**, then **Add Bot**.

| Bot | Link |
|---|---|
| Case Clerk | [https://x.ai/bot/TuGI6owtPK-_2rvVhnCqi](https://x.ai/bot/TuGI6owtPK-_2rvVhnCqi) |
| Manager | [https://x.ai/bot/jYDsF_XLTmGDAM1cmxTf-](https://x.ai/bot/jYDsF_XLTmGDAM1cmxTf-) |
| Intake Clerk | [https://x.ai/bot/GWvDg0sSZiCdx1GXucMiv](https://x.ai/bot/GWvDg0sSZiCdx1GXucMiv) |
| Messenger | [https://x.ai/bot/EuYNcmgfkyJfJnOAURC9v](https://x.ai/bot/EuYNcmgfkyJfJnOAURC9v) |
| Scout | [https://x.ai/bot/rEMFD4TMgX8v2vJ_xv2jB](https://x.ai/bot/rEMFD4TMgX8v2vJ_xv2jB) |

These are your copies. They do not change Vihaan’s templates, and they do not arrive with his sign-ins.

## 3. Connect Waypoint once

Connectors are shared by every bot on your Grok account, so do this one time.

In Grok Bot, open **Connect apps**, choose **Add a custom connector**, and enter:

- Name: `Waypoint`
- URL: `https://waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com/mcp`
- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer` and the key from Connect your Bots

If a bot asks for the key in chat, put it in the masked card it shows you. Do not paste it into a bot’s instructions.

Then ask any bot to list Waypoint’s tools. You should see `list_people`, `get_brief`, and `report_run`.

## 4. Sign in the other tools each bot calls

| Bot | What to connect |
|---|---|
| Manager | Waypoint only. It already holds the 2:00 AM schedule. |
| Intake Clerk | Waypoint only. It runs when you send it a document. |
| Case Clerk | Waypoint, plus its own computer and browser. When it asks for the mock portal, the sign-in printed on that portal is username `priya.sharma` and password `waypoint-demo-2026`. |
| Scout | Waypoint, X search, a browser, and Gmail. Sign Gmail into the Google account you want it to read. It should only open mail whose subject contains `[Waypoint demo]`. |
| Messenger | Waypoint, Google Calendar, and Gmail on that same Google account. It writes calendar events and Gmail drafts. It does not send mail. |

Gmail and Calendar are also account-wide. Sign in once, then every bot can use them.

## 5. Optional: let Check now wake the Manager

On Waypoint’s Connect page, copy the webhook message and send it to your Manager. Paste the webhook address and key it gives you back into that form. After that, **Check now** on the Brief starts a real run.

To confirm the connection, tell the Manager to run the night now. Within a few minutes the Brief should show a time under each bot, and the Activity lines should not say simulated.
